C0383.title: Multiple Ningbo Professional Store Closers Sentenced for Fraud in Prepaid Consumer Scam
C0383.summary: In February 2023, Qian, Li, Zheng, and others took over a struggling photo studio in Haishu District, Ningbo. Despite lacking operating conditions, they used an anniversary recharge campaign, promised refunds and high-value prizes, induced customers to keep paying, then closed the store and disappeared overnight after the event, defrauding victims of more than 1.46 million yuan. The Yinzhou District People's Court convicted Qian, Li, Zheng, and others of fraud, sentenced them to prison terms ranging from ten years and three months to ten years, and imposed fines; the second-instance court upheld the judgment.
